script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for March 29. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
You've been breathing since birth without thinking about it.  Asleep, distracted, unconscious—your lungs keep working.  Right now, 300 million tiny air sacs are exchanging oxygen for carbon dioxide.

Your lungs contain about 300 million alveoli—tiny air sacs where gas exchange happens. Unfold them and they'd cover half a tennis court. This enormous surface is crammed into your chest, maximizing contact between air and blood. You breathe about 20,000 times per day—that's 7. 3 million breaths per year.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: The body carries us while we focus on living.  Your lungs breathe whether you're thinking about it or not.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Breath Bridge - Connect Automatic and Conscious.

Here's your activity: Take five slow, deep breaths. Notice how conscious breathing affects your state—calming, centering, grounding. Breath is unique: an automatic system you can consciously influence. Use this bridge when you need to shift your internal state. This helps you use breath as a bridge between automatic and conscious systems.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about how lungs breathe for you can be applied to breath bridge - connect automatic and conscious. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
